watch.summary: A streamer attempts to hunt down an enemy hiding in an oil-painting style map, but prematurely celebrates shooting the wrong spot.

beats.what: Streamer explains an enemy is hiding somewhere in the chaotic painting environment.
The streamer hears taunting effects and knows the enemy is right underneath him.
He spots movement, screams in victory, and shoots.
He immediately realizes he mistook a killfeed notification/different player for his target.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Oh I just found him! Oh wait, no, no, no, no.
watch.why: The comedy comes from a sudden reversal of fortune when high-energy excitement instantly pivots into awkward realization. The creator's dramatic vocal shift makes the visual mistake landing clearer.
